introduction: Being in my first year out of education, I have gone on to work as a full-time ski instructor out in Canada, travelled from East to West on a once-in-a-lifetime journey, before settling down to work at a zipline business over in East Kootenay. My ultimate career goal is to become a qualified pilot, and I am particularly drawn to hands-on, practical training that allows me to apply my learning directly to my performance. I thrive both independently and in team settings, adapting well to different environments and challenges.
